name: com.empatica.empalink.EmpaLinkBLE
description: The Empatica Link Bluetooth component bundled with SSJ connects to Empatica E3 and E4 wristbands. When the app searches for a band, it discovers nearby devices, subscribes to their readings, and forwards sensor data to the app.
disableEffect: Empatica wristband discovery, connection, and sensor data will stop.
